examples.en: Tom always gets up early on school days.
examples.zh: 汤姆在上学日总是早起。

examples.en: My sister usually does her homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 我妹妹通常在晚饭前做作业。

examples.en: I often play basketball with my friends after school.
examples.zh: 放学后我经常和朋友们打篮球。

examples.en: We always go to the library on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我们周五下午总是去图书馆。

examples.en: The bus is usually late in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上的公交车通常晚点。

examples.en: She often reads books about pandas.
examples.zh: 她经常读关于熊猫的书。

examples.en: My father always drinks tea after dinner.
examples.zh: 我爸爸晚饭后总是喝茶。

examples.en: They usually walk to school, but sometimes they take the bus.
examples.zh: 他们通常步行上学，但有时坐公交车。

examples.en: He always does his homework in the classroom.
examples.zh: 他总是在教室里做作业。

examples.en: She usually goes to bed at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 她通常九点上床睡觉。

examples.en: I often see a cat in the park.
examples.zh: 我经常在公园里看到一只猫。

examples.en: We always have lunch at noon.
examples.zh: 我们总是在中午吃午饭。

examples.en: The teacher usually gives us homework on Mondays.
examples.zh: 老师通常在星期一给我们布置作业。

examples.en: They often visit the panda base on weekends.
examples.zh: 他们周末经常去熊猫基地。

examples.en: My mother always cooks hot pot on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我妈妈总是在星期天做火锅。

examples.en: He usually takes an umbrella when it rains.
examples.zh: 下雨时他通常带伞。

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.
examples.zh: 我睡觉前总是刷牙。

examples.en: She usually practices the piano in the evening.
examples.zh: 她晚上通常练习钢琴。

examples.en: We often play on the playground during recess.
examples.zh: 课间我们经常在操场上玩。

examples.en: My brother always helps me with my homework.
examples.zh: 我哥哥总是帮我做作业。

examples.en: The doctor usually comes to check on patients in the morning.
examples.zh: 医生通常在早上来检查病人。

examples.en: I often buy snacks at the shop after school.
examples.zh: 放学后我经常在商店买零食。

examples.en: They always water the flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 他们总是给花园里的花浇水。

examples.en: She often reads stories about pandas in her free time.
examples.zh: 她空闲时间经常读关于熊猫的故事。

scenes.title: 频度副词的位置
scenes.lead: 频度副词通常放在实义动词前，be 动词后。
scenes.sentence: Tom always gets up early. / She is always happy.
scenes.zh: 汤姆总是早起。 / 她总是很开心。

scenes.title: 频度副词的程度
scenes.lead: always 表示 100%，usually 表示 80%，often 表示 60%。
scenes.sentence: I always brush my teeth. / I usually do my homework. / I often read books.
scenes.zh: 我总是刷牙。 / 我通常做作业。 / 我经常读书。

scenes.title: 否定句中的频度副词
scenes.lead: 否定句中，频度副词放在 don't 后面。
scenes.sentence: I don't always eat fast food.
